description: Benchmark registry of wrmodes 1.0 (CONVENTIONS.md section 9). One entry per benchmark: what it checks, the reference and its type, the data file, the tolerance and the test or script that applies it. Created by WP7 (wave 1). status: 'reference ready' = reference data and comparison exist, waiting for the implementation; 'waiting for data' = needs L1 or COMSOL output; 'self-check' = validates a WP7 reference itself.

entries.reference: wrmodes 0.1 transfer-matrix solver (atol 1e-10, error_control='full'), product of segment transfer matrices
entries.tolerance: 1e-9 of input power, every output mode (WP7 acceptance)

entries.card: WP1 acceptance: WP7's global-ODE reference for three lines
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 of input power for every output mode (|S|^2 of S11, S21, S12, S22)

entries.component: WP1 Line with FrameChange (H and E bends)
entries.card: WP1 acceptance: WP7's global-ODE reference for three lines
entries.reference: WP7 global-ODE reference with independently derived frame relabelling (ref_frames.py), line 'mixed-planes', 20/30/40 GHz
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 of input power for every output mode

entries.component: WP1 Line with 10 m straights (paper section 7 sequence)
entries.card: WP1 acceptance: WP7's global-ODE reference for three lines
entries.reference: WP7 global-ODE reference, line 'long-straights' (21.4 m), 20/50/90 GHz
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 of input power for every output mode

entries.card: WP1 acceptance: FrameChange is a signed permutation; H -> E -> H is the identity
entries.reference: relabelling derived from the potentials (ref_frames.py docstring), checked against quadrature and wrmodes.modes.eplane_frame_signs
classical TE_mn / TM_mn attenuation formulas (Collin; Pozar eq. 3.96 for TE10)

entries.component: WP2 per-mode attenuation and lossy Straight

entries.reference: P_loss/(2P) with P_loss = (1/2) R_s oint |H_tan|^2 dl from transverse_field (ref_loss.py); WR-90 and 20 mm square, aluminium and copper; degenerate groups by eigenvalues of the wall-loss matrix
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 relative on alpha for every mode (every degenerate group)
entries.status: reference ready (WP2's attenuation function name is not fixed by its card: wire it in ref_interfaces.attenuation_function)
